entities.summary: Anna Ancher was a Danish artist associated with the Skagen Painters, an artist colony on the northern point of Jylland, Denmark. She is considered to be one of Denmark's greatest visual artists. Anna Ancher was a painters & sculptors from Skagen (1859-08-18, Skagen–1935-04-15). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
